biothings.name: bacillary angiomatosis
biothings.definition: A condition that is caused by infection with Bartonella, and which is characterized by vascular proliferation, usually in immunocompromised individuals. [NCIT:C3477]
biothings.synonyms: bacillary angiomatosis, bacillary epithelioid angiomatosis, Bartonella angiomatosis, Bartonella caused angiomatosis, epithelioid angiomatosis
